inspection.type:
∀ {k t : ℕ} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)},
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i j : QuarticQuery.Upper.Col t),
      i ≠ j →
        ∃ Z x o out F,
          QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpCost k t n) F ∧
            ∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (b : Bool),
              QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b =
                  QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpProb n x_1 i j) b ∧
                QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) (fun z => !out z) b =
                  QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpProb n x_1 j i) b

lean.note: Constructs one retained-workspace circuit and complementary output labels for the two ordered probabilities. The diagonal zero clause is a separate declaration.
The actual self-comparison probability is zero.
premises: Arbitrary natural repetition count, input and selected column.

presentation.body: For a fixed oracle input and a coherent comparison circuit, $a_{ij}$ is the probability that $i$ is reported as defeating $j$ when the result is measured, using one circuit per unordered pair; $a_{ii}=0$.
